plan.description: R1.5 class B, near-tied choice: the home project's storage milestone and the tools goal sit within affect's reach of each other. Horizons are experiment settings chosen against the affect half-lives (unease 1200, valence 6000, control 12000 ticks): short about one valence half-life, medium two control half-lives, long six. Development: may be inspected freely; never used to evaluate a model finally.
